title: The Bellows Ghost
text: In a ruined forge the bellows still pump on their own, wheezing, and the coals glow for no one. An anvil holds a blade half made, still cherry red. The hammer beside it is warm, as if the smith has only stepped out and will be back any moment.

options.label: The strongest takes up the warm hammer.

outcomes.text: The bellows breathe in time with the hammer, as if someone guides it, and the blade comes out fine.
The coals flare white at the first stroke, angry that a stranger dared.

options.label: Take the iron and the tools.

outcomes.text: Good iron and old tools, still sharp. The bellows wheeze faster as you carry them out.

options.label: Bank the fire, as a smith would.

outcomes.text: The bellows sigh to a stop, as if someone could rest at last.
